Check a QWAmetadata object

Source: R/QWAmetadata.R
check_QWAmetadata.Rd

Checks each component of a QWAmetadata object, as the final check of the metadata before a submission. Aborts if the object is not a valid QWAmetadata or if IDs in $sites, $trees, $woodpieces or $slides are not unique. Warns (or, with strict = TRUE, aborts) on:

  • a missing component required at the object's stage (see is_submission());

  • values violating the JSON schema of the stage;

  • duplicate values in columns that must be unique (e.g. email, site_name);

  • not exactly one contact person, or author_nr not numbering the authors from 1 to n;

  • country codes not in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2;

  • species codes not in the ITRDB list, or species columns of $trees not matching their code;

  • template placeholders left in the dataset description;

  • IDs or derived values (counts, parent labels, species_code) in the hierarchical tables not matching $images (resync with update_QWAmetadata());

  • issues in $images, see check_QWAimages().

Usage

check_QWAmetadata(x, strict = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A QWAmetadata object.

strict

If TRUE, abort on the first issue instead of warning.

Value

TRUE if no issue was found, FALSE otherwise (invisibly).

Details

Also informs about missing optional columns and absent optional components.

See also

QWAmetadata(), check_QWAimages(), check_consistency()
